scopeSemantics.SHARED_MODEL: The membership applies to every explicitly enumerated composition member; UNIT contribution does not copy scoped memberships onto siblings.
scopeSemantics.COMPOSITION_MEMBER: Exact composition-member recipients are authoritative; modelProfileSourceIds locate their shared statlines and must not widen recipients to other members of that statline.
